Measurement_Method: docker image inspect visitor-counter:baseline --format {{.Size}} and docker image inspect visitor-counter:optimized --format {{.Size}}
Explanation: Slim base image, no pip cache, only three runtime packages and a non-root user. Smaller pull size means faster scaling and less registry/disk usage.
The initial deployment reserved 0.5 CPU per Pod; measured idle usage is a few millicores, so the request was reduced to 100m (the HPA still targets 50% of it).
Idle Flask+gunicorn uses well under 128Mi; reserving 512Mi per Pod blocked memory that other workloads could schedule into.

Explanation: This is the number that maps to cluster capacity and therefore to cost in a real cloud.
